notes: Identity assessment: the exact title matches the neutral original reference. The text contains a substantive original-study manuscript with Methods, Results, Discussion, references, Figure 1 and Table 1, rather than an abstract or preregistration. The header describes an author-uploaded preprint parsed from ResearchGate; the expected binge-watching survey is present. However, authors, DOI, year and journal citation are not visibly reproduced, despite the header mentioning page 1 metadata. Primary-manuscript identity is therefore provisional pending parent review. No PDF is supplied, so no rendering was possible. The p.7 locator falls within manuscript measures, not results; Results occur on pp.8–9 and Figure 1 on p.16. The neutral relationship description and p.7 locator do not distinguish total, direct, or mediated effects. Figure 1 explicitly distinguishes direct and total effects; Results examine two mediation routes. Total-effect candidate standardized β = .38, p < .001. Autonomy-mediated candidate b = .03, LLCI = .01, ULCI = .06; goal-conflict/guilt-mediated candidate b = -.01, LLCI = -.03, ULCI = .01. The printed total-effect p is retained as candidate evidence only because the intended test is unresolved. Indirect effects are reported with bootstrap confidence intervals rather than p values, and their b metric is not established as standardized beta. The text parse loses Figure 1 arrow layout, preventing reliable assignment of detached direct-effect coefficients. Source identity remains provisional because authors/DOI are not visible. Unassigned fields are placeholders. No N derivation or metric conversion performed.
